settings.languagesHint: Choose which languages can run. Remote languages send your code to an online playground and are off by default.
settings.htmlRuntimeBrowserDesc: Renders in a closed Shadow DOM: inline <script> does not run, and styles stay scoped to the block.
settings.htmlRuntimeIframeDesc: Renders in a sandboxed iframe: scripts run, isolated from the note (opaque origin, no same-origin access).
settings.jsRuntimeLocalDesc: Runs in an async function in the renderer: BOM, DOM and Typora globals are blocked, but this is not a security sandbox. Loops time out after 5s, which cannot fully prevent infinite loops.
settings.jsRuntimeOneCompilerDesc: Sends the code to the OneCompiler JavaScript playground: isolated from Typora, requires network access.
settings.tsRuntimeLocalDesc: Transpiled with Sucrase, then run as JavaScript in the renderer. Loops time out after 5s, which cannot fully prevent infinite loops.
settings.tsRuntimeOneCompilerDesc: Sends the code to the OneCompiler TypeScript playground: isolated from Typora, requires network access.
settings.nodeRuntimeLocalDesc: Runs in-process through Node's `vm`: CommonJS-style scope with `require` access, no network needed. Loops time out after 5s, which cannot fully prevent infinite loops.
settings.nodeRuntimeOneCompilerDesc: Sends the code to the OneCompiler Node.js playground: isolated from Typora, requires network access.
